articles.title: Asian stocks mostly fall after Wall Street losses and oil prices rise
articles.description: Asian shares have mostly declined following Wall Street losses, and U.S. Treasury yields steadied after reaching their highest in roughly two decades. U.S. futures have edged lower. Meanwhile, oil prices have risen over uncertainties over U.S.-Iran negotiations and the possibility of a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, the crucial waterway for oil transport. On Monday, Wall Street's benchmark S&P 500 slipped 0.8%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.7%, and the Nasdaq composite dropped 0.9%. Stocks were under pressure in part as the yields on U.S. Treasuries continued to gain, with investors looking for higher returns under growing worries about inflation and rising government debt in the United States.
